content:
The **Fancy Pump Action Shotgun** is a shotgun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

## Gameplay

An ornate weapon made with a darker wood and painted black with gold trim. The receiver is engraved with a golden floral pattern and the forearm is painted with four white diamonds.

It has an increased ammo capacity and reload speed compared to the standard Pump Action Shotgun. It is equipped with a special receiver, barrel and stock, but can't use normal shotgun mods.

The weapon comes with the following Legendary Weapon Mods pre-attached:

## Locations

The weapon has a 1.5% chance to be earned as a reward for turning in a Pleasant Valley Claim Ticket to the bellhop in the basement of the Pleasant Valley Ski Resort. Claim tickets are only available after completing the Key to the Past main quest.

Like the Fancy Single Action Revolver, it cannot be modified. It can be repaired at a Weapon Workbench if the condition drops below 100%, but will otherwise be hidden from the menu.
